commentary.text: 90+15' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+14' Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The ball is out of play. FC Koln will take a throw-in.
90+13' Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) was too forceful with his tackle and Deniz Aytekin interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
90+12' Ragnar Ache (1. FC Koln) jumps for a cross in the goal area and produces a fine header which goes just a few inches over the bar! What a huge opportunity!
90+12' Sebastian Sebulonsen (1. FC Koln) meets a cross just outside the area and gets in a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
90+11' Giovanni Reyna (B. Monchengladbach) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
90+9' The foul by Marius Bulter (1. FC Koln) was seen by Deniz Aytekin who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.

90+7' Ragnar Ache (1. FC Koln) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception. The ball has crossed the sideline. FC Koln are taking a throw-in.
90+6' The game has come to an end for Rocco Reitz. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Oscar Fraulo (B. Monchengladbach).
90+5' Yannik Engelhardt (B. Monchengladbach) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
90+4' Ragnar Ache (1. FC Koln) commits a rough challenge and Deniz Aytekin blows his whistle for a foul. B. Monchengladbach have been awarded a free kick.
90+2' 3 - 1 Goal! Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Moritz Nicolas to commit before slotting the penalty into the top right corner.
90+2' Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) is going to take the penalty!

90+1' Lukas Ullrich (B. Monchengladbach) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Deniz Aytekin with no other option than to blow for a foul. FC Koln are awarded a penalty kick!
90' The fourth official shows 11 min. of added time.
90' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from FC Koln.
88' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
86' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 2:6. Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 7:12.

84' Shuto Machino (B. Monchengladbach) connects with a cross and has an effort on goal from the edge of the box, but it ends somewhere in row Z. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for FC Koln.
80' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Isak Johannesson as he is replaced by Alessio Castro-Montes (1. FC Koln).
78' Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Deniz Aytekin blows his whistle for a foul.
77' FC Koln force their opponents to concede a corner.
76' Eugen Polanski prepares a substitution. Franck Honorat is replaced by Shuto Machino (B. Monchengladbach).
75' Substitution. Florian Neuhaus makes way for Giovanni Reyna (B. Monchengladbach).
75' Sebastian Sebulonsen (1. FC Koln) goes into the referee's book for dissent.
75' Tempers flare after Ragnar Ache (1. FC Koln) commits a foul. He receives a yellow card for his bad challenge and surely must be relieved at not receiving a red card.
75' Kevin Diks (B. Monchengladbach) is shown a yellow card for a late challenge.
73' Ragnar Ache (1. FC Koln) behaves unsportingly.
72' PENALTY APPEAL after Isak Johannesson (1. FC Koln) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
72' The resulting corner from Isak Johannesson (1. FC Koln) is cleared.
72' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
72' Chance! Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) was in a good position inside the box, but he couldn't connect with the pass as it was overhit.

68' Ragnar Ache (1. FC Koln) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball low to the middle of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
68' The ball goes behind for a corner. FC Koln will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
67' Substitution. Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) replaces Cenk Ozkacar.
67' Lukas Kwasniok has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) replacing Kristoffer Lund.
67' Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln) expertly controls a neat clever pass on the edge of the penalty area, but his effort smashes against the crossbar! What an opportunity!
64' 3 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Franck Honorat sprays a pass out to Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach), and he has an easy job to slot the ball into an empty net. The score is 3:0.
63' The manager makes a subsitution with Marvin Friedrich (B. Monchengladbach) coming on for Philipp Sander.
61' 2 - 0 Goal! Marvin Schwabe gets a hand on the penalty from Kevin Diks (B. Monchengladbach), but can't stop it from flying into the bottom right corner.
61' Kevin Diks (B. Monchengladbach) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
60' It’s a PENALTY to B. Monchengladbach after the VAR review!
60' Referee Deniz Aytekin makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for B. Monchengladbach. Let’s see what happens!
59' Kristoffer Lund (1. FC Koln) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.
58' Kristoffer Lund (1. FC Koln) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
57' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Ragnar Ache (1. FC Koln), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
55' Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.

51' Isak Johannesson (1. FC Koln) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for B. Monchengladbach.
50' Isak Johannesson (1. FC Koln) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.

48' What a chance that is! Marius Bulter (1. FC Koln) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box, but he blazes it just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and B. Monchengladbach will have a goal kick.
48' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) dribbles into the box, but Marvin Schwabe is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
48' Ragnar Ache (1. FC Koln) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
47' The FC Koln players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
46' Half-time substitution. Lukas Kwasniok decided to make a change. Said El Mala (1. FC Koln) is replaced by Sebastian Sebulonsen.
46' Half-time substitution. Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) is replaced by Ragnar Ache.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+4' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from FC Koln was in an offside position.
45+2' 1 - 0 Goal! Philipp Sander (B. Monchengladbach) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 1:0.
45+2' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to B. Monchengladbach.

45+2' Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) places the ball on the penalty spot and sends it towards the bottom left corner. His effort isn't powerful enough, allowing Marvin Schwabe to dive and keep the ball out with an excellent save.
45+1' Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' The B. Monchengladbach players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!

44' There's a break in play and referee Deniz Aytekin must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by B. Monchengladbach using VAR. This could be interesting!
43' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
42' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
40' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
40' The linesman makes the right call and B. Monchengladbach will have a corner.
39' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
36' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
36' Philipp Sander (B. Monchengladbach) takes a cheeky throw-in and sets up a counter-attack for his team.
35' Joel Schmied (1. FC Koln) commits a rough foul. Deniz Aytekin stops the game and makes a call.
34' Denis Huseinbasic (1. FC Koln) has tested the patience of referee Deniz Aytekin and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
33' FC Koln are playing some nice combination football, sending it precisely from player to player, but a defender shows good anticipation and ends the move with a good block.
30' Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
29' Said El Mala (1. FC Koln) fails to beat the offside trap. The flag goes up and the referee blows his whistle.
27' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
27' Nico Elvedi (B. Monchengladbach) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. It's a free kick to FC Koln, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
25' 2:3 – the total goal attempt statistics. The shots on goal statistics – 0:2.
23' Isak Johannesson (1. FC Koln) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The ball is out of play. B. Monchengladbach will have a throw-in.
22' Said El Mala (1. FC Koln) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
20' The ball is cleared after Said El Mala (1. FC Koln) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
19' Dangerous play by Joel Schmied (1. FC Koln). Deniz Aytekin blows his whistle for a foul. B. Monchengladbach get a free kick.
18' Joel Schmied (1. FC Koln) picks up an injury.
18' Said El Mala (1. FC Koln) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards goal, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper.
16' Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) meets the lofted pass inside the box with a well placed shot towards the middle of the goal, but Marvin Schwabe pulls off a fantastic save to deny him.

13' Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass. Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.

13' So close! Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) delivers a cross into the box, it almost finds the head of one of his teammates, but one of the defenders is quickest to the ball and coolly deals with the threat.
12' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) was quite harsh and Deniz Aytekin didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
10' The corner by Isak Johannesson (1. FC Koln) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.

10' Marius Bulter (1. FC Koln) zig-zags his way into the box and drills a low shot towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a superb stop. The linesman points to the corner flag, FC Koln are going to take it.
9' Said El Mala (1. FC Koln) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
8' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
7' FC Koln enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.

6' Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Deniz Aytekin stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. A free kick is awarded to B. Monchengladbach.
5' Kristoffer Lund (1. FC Koln) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
4' Philipp Sander (B. Monchengladbach) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.

3' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and FC Koln will have the kick-off.
Deniz Aytekin is introduced as the referee for today's match.
